information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzYyMDMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b461cbfe0cad33e2120f14293fe68e84c3bb5009/sac_transparent%20(1).png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODkwMjAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--2a39206c60ab27be42e021502bbacb48d813a4c3/main_small.png) #### From the organizers that brought you SacCubing, comes SacQuiet Winter 2027! #### **This competition will be specializing in quiet events and will not have 3x3 or any traditional events.** If you would like to sign up for a competition involving those events, please check out [SacCubing XXV 2027,](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SacCubingXXV2027/) happening on January 17th, the day after. * *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* * We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. * All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue fees, supplies and other competition expenses.
